line: Crowley’s Ace of Disks: the Root of the Powers of Earth, Kether for the Aces, no planet-in-sign.

sections.title: What Crowley names
sections.line: The chapter heading for the card. The second quotation gives the element of its suit.

quotes.quote: THE ROOT OF THE POWERS OF EARTH

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The Aces essay places the four Aces together at Kether. The Ace of Disks chapter gives no planet-in-sign. The quarter line places the Disks over Europe and Africa.

quotes.quote: On the other hand, Spirit represents Kether.
Cups the Pacific Ocean, Swords the Americas, Disks Europe and Africa

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley says the Ace pictures the entry of the Energy called Earth, and that the Disks are a whirling emblem rather than coins.

quotes.quote: The Ace of Disks pictures the entry of that type of Energy which is called Earth.
Nor are the Disks any more to be considered as Coins; the Disk is a whirling emblem.
